test_case.test_name: AMD in-band MMHUB uncorrectable driver/VM reporting
test_case.purpose: Prove one approved MMHUB UCE targets the intended GPU, is reported by the driver with correct VM-path attribution and can be recovered safely.
required_package: GPU UUID/OAM/BDF and omitted -d default-selection proof
Driver/firmware ras_enable lifecycle and MMHUB/VM dmesg oracle
test_case.test_command: Qualified operator records GPU/process/driver/RAS/log baseline, safely verifies ras_enable=1, runs the limited source UMC query, proves default GPU selection, executes `amdgpuras -b 3 -s 0 -t 4` once, captures exact success and timestamped MMHUB/VM dmesg context, checks for reset/error storm, then performs approved recovery and restores driver state.
test_case.expected_result: Only the intended GPU receives the MMHUB UCE; tool success and approved MMHUB/VM driver fields appear within timeout, no uncontrolled storm persists, and GPU memory-management/driver health is restored.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires target/tool/driver identity, one injection, MMHUB-specific dmesg/VM attribution and completed recovery. Ambiguous target, generic GFX/UMC error, wrong block, hang or failed VM health fails/blocks.
safety_gate: Critical injection approval on dedicated idle GPU SUT.
Do not run until default target and active GPU mappings are verified.
Preserve baseline logs and VM state; no blanket clear.
One injection only; no automatic retry/reset/reboot.
expected_evidence: Limited UMC query plus default-target proof
Timestamped MMHUB/VM dmesg and storm/reset check
Recovery, restored module state and all-GPU health
test_case.recovery: On VM fault storm, wrong GPU, reset or hang, preserve logs and use only approved reset/rebind/reboot/OOB recovery; never retry automatically and restore ras_enable/module state.
